# Adversarial intake corpus — 26 files

Generated by `tests/intake_adversarial_corpus.py`, regenerated with
`python scripts/gen_intake_corpus.py`, and pinned byte-for-byte by
`tests/test_intake_adversarial.py::test_committed_fixtures_match_the_generator`.
**Do not hand-edit these files.** Change the generator and regenerate.

They are committed rather than written at test time (the convention
`tests/inference_corpus.py` uses) because half of them exist to test *bytes* — a
BOM, a bare CR, a cp1252 high byte, an embedded NUL. Bytes that only ever live
inside a test run have never been proved to survive a checkout. `.gitattributes`
marks the directory `-text` so git never normalises the line endings that are
the whole point of several files.

Every spectrum carries a 1x line at 30 Hz (1800 rpm), a 2x line, and BPFO at
107.03 Hz — so a file that reads correctly is analysable, and a file that reads
incorrectly is visibly so. `FMAX` 250 Hz, 501 bins, 0.5 Hz resolution.

## What each file is for

| File | Shape | Correct recipe must |
|---|---|---|
| `utf16le_bom.txt` | Excel "Unicode Text" export, UTF-16 LE + BOM, tabs | read it |
| `utf16be_bom.txt` | UTF-16 BE + BOM, semicolons | read it |
| `utf8_bom_nohdr.txt` | UTF-8 BOM, **no header** so the BOM lands on datum 1 | read all 501 rows |
| `cp1252_degrees.txt` | cp1252 header with `°`, `µ`, `±`; CRLF | read it |
| `crlf.txt` | DOS CRLF throughout | read it |
| `bare_cr.dat` | bare CR, no LF anywhere in the file | read it |
| `decimal_comma_cpm.txt` | German export: CPM axis, `1800,00`, semicolons | read it |
| `thousands_eu_dot.txt` | EU grouping `1.800,00` | read it |
| `thousands_space.txt` | SI grouping `1 800,00` | read it |
| `scientific.txt` | `3.000000E+01` in both columns | read it |
| `scientific_eu.asc` | `3,000000E+01` — EU decimals *and* exponents | read it |
| `comments_blanks.dat` | `#` comments and blanks interleaved through the data | read it, drop the junk |
| `numeric_footer.txt` | numeric statistics block appended after the data | **gate must refuse** (axis restarts) |
| `truncated.txt` | transfer died mid-row | drop the partial row only |
| `fixed_width.txt` | column-aligned, 3 over-range rows merge into one field | drop the 3, keep 498 |
| `two_blocks.txt` | two spectra (1H then 1V) in one file | **gate must refuse** (axis restarts) |
| `binary_tail.txt` | clean text head, binary blob after 10 KB | read the text, drop the blob |
| `binary_head.txt` | binary bytes wearing a `.txt` suffix | **sample must refuse** |
| `non_monotonic.txt` | axis reverses for 110 rows mid-file | **gate must refuse** |
| `negative_amps.txt` | every third amplitude negative (a phase/real-part column) | **gate must refuse** |
| `all_zero.txt` | axis intact, every amplitude exactly 0 | **gate must refuse** |
| `db_units.txt` | dB-scaled amplitudes — no honest velocity reading exists | read with `unknown` units, no severity |
| `accel_ms2.asc` | acceleration in m/s², pipe-delimited | read it, **never** claim severity |
| `orders_no_speed.txt` | shaft-order axis, no speed in the file | read it via the form's RPM |
| `numeric_preamble.dat` | numeric `bins fmin fmax` line above headerless data | read it with `skip_rows=1` |
| `prose_report.txt` | a narrative report with three numbers in it | **executor must refuse** |

## The immune half

`tests/test_intake_adversarial.py::TestImmuneToWrongRecipes` runs
*plausibly wrong* recipes over these same files — a comma read as a thousands
mark on a decimal-comma file, CPM read as Hz, orders read as Hz, dB declared as
mm/s, a column index off by one, `skip_rows` off by one. Every one of them must
end in a refusal (executor) or a `fail` Check (gate). A wrong recipe that
produces a Case the gate accepts is the highest-class finding this corpus can
surface, and `test_no_wrong_recipe_survives` is written to fail if one appears.
